description: The review applies McGaghie's proposed levels of simulation-based translational outcomes, adapted to direct ophthalmoscopy, as an effectiveness assessment framework.
title: McGaghie's five-level simulation-based translational outcomes framework

description: The study frames institutional elearning contexts using two axes: an elearning policy typology (Structured versus Unstructured, defined by policy document, formal support unit and institution-wide LMS) and McNay's (1995) taxonomy of organisational cultures.
title: McNay's four-type organisational culture taxonomy combined with Structured/Unstructured e-learning policy types as an analytic framework
